items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: We used to play a program for them every Sunday. On WWL... The staff orchestra... And that's Al Fisher Hill. On bass.

ctx.x: Okay. You're saying the cello player's name?

It was Marcel Dorman, one of the finest in the country. He had that reputation. But he's known to Yo-Yo Ma, I don't think. And that's Al Fisher Hill. On bass. Yeah, on the bass. In other words, I took the tuba and took the picture with the tuba, so make room here. But that was a combination. This was the Hillcrest office. We used to play a program for them every Sunday. On WWL. On WWL, yeah. The staff orchestra.
